defs.def: to begin doing or using sth 开始，着手，动手（做或使用）

ex.s: I decided that I wanted to learn as many words as I could and started marking every entry I looked up with a pencil to measure my progress.
ex.t: 那时我决心要尽可能多地学单词，并开始用铅笔标记每一个查过的词条，以此来衡量自己的进步。

ex.s: As a new unit started, I asked everyone to write a persuasive piece on a health-related topic of their choice.
ex.t: 随着新单元开始，我让每个人就自己选择的健康相关话题写一篇说服性文章。

ex.s: It started to rain and everyone went indoors.
ex.t: 开始下雨了，大家都进了屋。

ex.s: Using an old 3D printer, Mark started experimenting.
ex.t: 用一台旧3D打印机，Mark开始了尝试。

ex.s: Feeling desperate, Eva started using a mind trick on herself.
ex.t: 感到绝望的伊娃开始对自己使用心理技巧。

ex.s: I started getting really nervous.
ex.t: 我开始变得非常紧张。

ex.s: Before starting any position, all students need to complete required taforms and show identification.
ex.t: 在开始任何职位之前，所有学生需要完成必要的表格并出示身份证件。

ex.s: At 13, she started to sit in on cooking classes.
ex.t: 13岁时，她开始坐在烹饪课上。

ex.s: By using the latest technologies, drones could also start providing higher-value services for railways, detecting faults in the rail or switches, before they can cause any safety problems.
ex.t: 通过使用最新技术，无人机还可以开始为铁路提供更高价值的服务，在铁轨或道岔的故障引发安全问题之前就检测出来。

ex.s: We started to meet regularly to draw up our plans.
ex.t: 我们开始定期见面制定计划。

ex.s: Everything was going smoothly until Jeff started frying the bread.
ex.t: 平底锅太热了，面包几秒钟内就变黑了。

ex.s: Then Jeff noticed steam shooting out of the pot and the lid starting to shake.
ex.t: 下一分钟粥溢出来了，把火浇灭了。

ex.s: They started fighting each other.
ex.t: 他们开始互相打斗。

ex.s: Everything was going smoothly until Jeff started frying the bread.
ex.t: 平底锅太热了，面包几秒钟内就变黑了。

ex.s: Then Jeff noticed steam shooting out of the pot and the lid starting to shake.
ex.t: 下一分钟粥溢出来了，把火浇灭了。

ex.s: The uncertainty was starting to wear on us, so I wanted to do something special.
ex.t: 这种不确定性开始让我们感到压力所以我想做点特别的事情。

ex.s: I started a third drawer for these big discoveries.
ex.t: 我为这些重大发现开了第三个抽屉。

ex.s: It just started licking（舔）Ehlers’ face.
ex.t: 它刚刚开始舔埃勒斯的脸。

ex.s: “She started shaking.
ex.t: “她开始颤抖。

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

ex.s: Why did the author start to use the “library”?
ex.t: 作者为什么开始使用这个“图书馆”？

ex.s: Which of the following starts earliest?
ex.t: 以下哪项开始得最早？

ex.s: A rethink is required — and as a new approach starts to become apparent, two ideas stand out.
ex.t: 需要重新思考——随着一种新的方法开始显现，有两个观点脱颖而出。

ex.s: So I’ve put together some good tips for starting an art journey.
ex.t: 因此，我整理了一些开始艺术之旅的好技巧。

ex.s: He quickly   63   （throw）his tools aside, and started running, arms out.
ex.t: 他迅速   63  （throw）扔下工具，张开双臂跑过去。

ex.s: Parry quickly graduated from his early hearts and sharks, and started to surprise families with drawings that captured young patients’ personalities.
ex.t: 帕里很快不再画最初的心形和鲨鱼，而是开始用捕捉小患者个性的画作给各个家庭带来惊喜。

ex.s: Now, Cao has started the second part of his dream to walk along the Belt and Road route.
ex.t: 现在，曹已经开始了他梦想的第二部分——沿着一带一路路线行走。

ex.s: When I started running in my 30s, I realized running was a battle against myself, not about competition or whether or not I was athletic.
ex.t: 在我30多岁开始跑步时，我意识到跑步是一场与自己的较量，而不是关乎竞争或我是否有运动天赋。

ex.s: But how did you deal with new challenges, like starting a new course?
ex.t: 但你是如何应对新的挑战的，比如开始一门新课程？

ex.s: It is never too late to start.
ex.t: 什么时候开始都不算晚。

ex.s: *Start your job search by clicking “Jobs” button.
ex.t: *点击"Jobs"按钮开始职位搜索。

ex.s: When does the comparison game start?
ex.t: 比较游戏什么时候开始？

ex.s: When will the film start?
ex.t: 电影什么时候开始？

ex.s: Before we start, please come to the front one by one and introduce yourself to the class.
ex.t: 在我们开始之前，请一个接一个地来到前面，向全班介绍自己。

ex.s: The problem comes when you start doing too much complaint-based humor.
ex.t: 问题在于你开始做太多基于抱怨的幽默。

ex.s: With everything ready, Bernard started out on his new business.
ex.t: 成为下一个明星记者、新闻撰稿人、导演或制片人。

ex.s: I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going and start paying close attention.”
ex.t: 我漏看了那一段，因为我在想别的事情，但我会继续读下去，并开始集中注意力。"

ex.s: Then, start denying yourself the right in order to break the habit.
ex.t: 然后，开始拒绝自己的这种权利以打破这个习惯。

ex.s: Hearing Dad’s cheerfulness, I realised that what I’d been seeing as “the end of an era” was actually the start of a new one.
ex.t: 听到爸爸的欢快，我意识到我一直视为“一个时代终结”的事情，其实是一个新时代的开始。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
ex.t: 在我40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，让我开始画画。

ex.s: Here’s a riddle: What do traffic jams, long lines and waiting for a vacation to start all have in common?
ex.t: 来猜个谜语：交通堵塞、排长队和等待假期开始，这三者的共同点是什么？

ex.s: You’ll soon find that the more patience you practice, the more you start to apply it to other, more annoying situations.
ex.t: 你很快就会发现，你练习的耐心越多，你就越开始把它运用到其他更恼人的情境中。

ex.s: Think Before You Start
ex.t: 开始之前先思考。

ex.s: And among people who don't exercise, the changes can start even sooner.
ex.t: 而在不运动的人身上，这些变化可能开始得更早。

ex.s: "The sweet spot in life to start exercising, if you haven't already, is in late middle age when the heart still has flexibility," Levine says.
ex.t: "如果你还没有开始运动，生命中开始运动的最佳时期是中年晚期，这时心脏仍有弹性，"Levine说。

ex.s: It is never too late for people to start taking exercise.
ex.t: 开始运动永远不嫌晚。

ex.s: Sullivan talked about it with Judy and they decided to start making wooden toys to give away to kids on New Year’s Day.
ex.t: 沙利文和朱迪谈了这事，决定开始制作木制玩具，在新年那天送给孩子们。

ex.s: Actually, I start to learn kung fu when I was seven years old, for I have long been out of practice.
ex.t: 其实，我是七岁开始学功夫的，因为我很久没练了。

ex.s: Tyson left for college, so I had to start at a new school all by myself.
ex.t: 泰森去上大学了，所以我不得不独自在一所新学校重新开始。

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在就应该开始思考，如何确保无人驾驶车辆的出现不会放大我们今天这种以汽车为主导的交通体系中最糟糕的方面。

ex.s: These advertise the presence of chicks to adults; they might also encourage our chick to start calling as well.
ex.t: 这些（叫声）向成鸟宣告雏鸟的存在；它们也可能促使我们的雏鸟也开始鸣叫。

ex.s: “What I’m hoping to accomplish is that my generation and younger start to reconsider and understand that jazz is not black and write anymore.
ex.t: 我希望实现的是，我们这一代和更年轻的一代开始重新思考并理解，爵士乐不再是非黑即白的了。

ex.s: When I finally started to study, I would race through the assigned work, often well past midnight.
ex.t: 等我终于开始学习时，我会匆匆忙忙赶完布置的作业，常常早已过了午夜。

ex.s: Soon afterwards, many of those people started settling down to become farmers, and their languages too became more settled and fewer in number.
ex.t: 不久之后，那些人中的许多开始定居下来成为农民，他们的语言也随之变得更加稳定，数量也减少了。

ex.s: You could not take back a book to the library on the same day you’d taken it out; it made no difference to her that you’d read every word in it and needed another to start.
ex.t: 你不能在借书当天就把书还回图书馆；即便你把里面每个字都读了、需要另一本开始读，对她来说也没区别。

ex.s: What time does Dave's meeting start?
ex.t: 戴夫的会议几点开始？

ex.s: Then it starts all over again the next month.
ex.t: 然后下个月一切又重新开始。

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.
ex.t: “我经常给家人和朋友寄明信片，”他对《中国日报》说，“但你可以想象，过一阵子后，你收到的永远不会和你寄出的一样多，你会意识到不是每个人都像你一样热衷于它____32____”不过，为了寻找其他志同道合的人，保罗开始在一个不太可能的地方寻找：网上。

ex.s: The Chinese Ministry of Agriculture finds that between 2005 – when the government   68   (start) a soil – testing program   69   gives specific fertilizer recommendations to farmers – and 2011, fertilizer use dropped by 7.7 million tons.
ex.t: 中国农业部发现，在2005年（政府___68___ start一项为农民提供具体施肥建议的测土配方项目）至2011年间，化肥使用量下降了770万吨。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: Jordan said that no matter how it ends, it starts with hope.
ex.t: 约旦说，无论结局如何，都以希望为起点。

defs.def: to start happening; to make sth start happening （使）发生，开始进行

ex.s: Life on city streets started to change decades ago.
ex.t: 几十年前，城市街道上的生活开始发生变化。

ex.s: When will Henry start his vacation?
ex.t: Henry什么时候开始度假？

ex.s: （1）What made the author start to climb up the stairs to the mountain top？（no more than 5 words）
ex.t: （4）你如何理解最后一段中划线的句子？（不超过5个词）

ex.s: Let’s start with kowtow.
ex.t: 对于皇帝来说，这种行为要求那个人将头触地。

ex.s: Because sleepiness is such a problem for teenagers, some school districts have decided to start high school classes later than they used to.
ex.t: 身体内称为激素的化学物质水平的变化不仅使青少年的身体发育出成人特征，还使青少年难以在晚上11点前入睡。

ex.s: In a recycling economy, we would make one set of 100 cans to start with, then replace them over and over again with recycled cans.
ex.t: 在一个循环回收经济中，我们会先制造一组100个罐子，然后再用回收的罐子反复替换它们。

ex.s: a small number of measles cases can start a dangerous trend
ex.t: 少量麻疹病例就可能引发一个危险趋势。

defs.def: when you start a machine or a vehicle or it starts, it begins to operate 开动；发动；启动

ex.s: She has started a new programme.
ex.t: 她启动了一个新节目。

ex.s: Before getting into the car, I thought I had learned the instructor’s orders, so once I started the car, my mind goes blank.
ex.t: 在上车之前，我以为已经记住了教练的指令，可一旦发动车子，我的大脑就一片空白。

ex.s: How should you start?
ex.t: 如何 開場 ？

ex.s: After a heated discussion that lasted for what seemed like a century, Gunter put his phone down and started the car.
ex.t: 在一场似乎持续了一个世纪的激烈讨论后，冈特放下手机，发动了车。

ex.s: After a heated discussion that lasted for what seemed like a century, Gunter put his phone down and started the car.
ex.t: 在一场似乎持续了一个世纪的激烈讨论后，冈特放下手机，发动了车。

ex.s: Why did BART start the kiosk program?
ex.t: BART为什么启动自助亭项目？

ex.s: start the smoke detector in a fire
ex.t: C．在火灾中启动烟雾探测器

ex.s: I tried to turn on my brain but the engine just wouldn't start.” I should say my name, of course.
ex.t: “我试图启动我的大脑，可引擎就是打不着火。”当然，我应该说我的名字。

ex.s: In library bocks and computers, you can find information on starting a business.
ex.t: 如果你想拥有自己的事业，当地图书馆可以成为你的启动空间。

defs.def: to begin to exist; to make sth begin to exist （使）出现；发起；创办；开办

ex.s: They will start their own company.
ex.t: 他们将创办自己的公司。

ex.s: start up a new department
ex.t: 创办一个新部门

ex.s: So she desired to get round the warning, "Why can't I make a healthy candy that's good for my teeth so that my parents can't say no to it?" With that in mind, Moore asked her dad if she could start her own candy company.
ex.t: 于是她渴望避开这个警告：'为什么我不能做一种对牙齿有益的健康糖果，这样我父母就不会拒绝它呢？'带着这个想法，Moore 问她父亲她是否能创办自己的糖果公司。

ex.s: start campaigns rapidly     D. spread  information widely
ex.t: 迅速发起活动     D. 广泛传播信息

ex.s: She started the Ladybug Foundation, an organization aiming at getting rid of homelessness.
ex.t: 她创办了Ladybug基金会，这是一个旨在摆脱无家可归状况的组织。

ex.s: Last year, the couple’s daughter started a GoFundMe to help cover the costs of some materials and tools.
ex.t: 去年，这对夫妇的女儿发起了一个GoFundMe众筹，帮助支付一些材料和工具的费用。

ex.s: Summer Company provides students with hands-on business training and awards of up to $3,000 to start and run their own summer businesses.
ex.t: 夏季公司项目为学生提供实践性商业培训和最高3,000美元的奖励，用于创办和运营他们自己的暑期企业。

ex.s: And at first it is, says Abby Jaramillo, who with another teacher started Urban Sprouts, a school garden program at four low-income schools.
ex.t: 起初确实如此，阿比·哈拉米略说，她和另一位老师创办了"城市新芽"——一个在四所低收入学校开展的校园菜园项目。

defs.def: to begin a journey; to leave 出发；动身；起程

ex.s: Where does the guided city tour start?
ex.t: 导游城市游览从哪里出发？

ex.s: The  58  is scheduled to start on December 21 in New York City and continue on to Milan, Prague, Paris, Bangkok and New Delhi before  59  in Toronto on January 8.
ex.t: 这趟____计划于12月21日在纽约出发，然后继续前往米兰、布拉格、巴黎、曼谷和新德里，最终于1月8日____多伦多。

defs.def: to begin to move in a particular direction 起身走向；向 … 而去

ex.s: Over the last two years, some supermarkets   62   (start) selling chicken or salad in packs   63   (design) with two halves containing separate portions (份).
ex.t: 在过去两年里，一些超市开始销售鸡肉或沙拉，包装设计成两半，分别装有独立的份量。

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 话虽如此，随着发令枪响，我会全力扎进冷水中，尽可能快地游向泳池另一边，却发现其他游泳者从我身边滑过。

defs.def: to begin, or to begin sth such as a career, in a particular way that changed later 以 … 起步（或起家）；起初是

ex.s: On the other occasion, they ate a rich morning meal about two hours before they started walking.
ex.t: 然后，在这些男性两次早上访问实验室时，每个人都以平均速度步行一小时，理论上应该让身体主要依靠脂肪作为燃料。

ex.s: "The day starts at dawn on my farm," he said.
ex.t: 下午，我问叔叔保罗我是否可以骑马，他说可以，只要爸爸跟我一起去。

ex.s: “We are going to make a change, ”she said.“I’ve started a project to promote the teaching of the arts in our schools.”
ex.t: 这个项目的起因是许多学校难以邀请各类艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐家还是著名电影明星——来学校和孩子们交流并激励他们。

ex.s: Some students get so interested in gardening that they bring home seeds to start their own vegetable gardens.
ex.t: 一些学生对园艺非常感兴趣，以至于把种子带回家，开辟自己的菜园。

ex.s: They have transformed themselves into places where you can develop your love of knowledge meet interesting people, or find out how to start a business.
ex.t: 它们已经把自己转变成了这样的地方：你可以在这里培养对知识的热爱、结识有趣的人，或者了解如何创业。

ex.s: Carducci believes developing such a sense of belonging starts with small talk.
ex.t: Carducci 认为，培养这种归属感始于闲聊。

ex.s: Farber, a graduate of Colorado State University, started out as a more conventional veterinarian.
ex.t: Farber是科罗拉多州立大学的毕业生，起初是一名较为传统的兽医。

ex.s: How was Detrinidad’s business when it started?
ex.t: 德特里尼达的生意刚起步时怎么样？

ex.s: Today his hobby has developed into the website postcrossing.com, a social network that has grown to 575,217 registered users in 214 countries and regions since he started it 10 years ago.
ex.t: 如今，他的爱好已发展成一个网站 postcrossing.com——一个社交网络，自他十年前创建以来，已发展到214个国家和地区的575,217名注册用户。

ex.s: What started as an experiment is now more of a philosophy.
ex.t: 起初只是一次实验，如今更像一种理念。

defs.def: to begin from a particular place, amount or situation （从 … ）开始；（由 … ）起

ex.s: Accordingly, I started by experimenting with water colours.
ex.t: 相应地，我从水彩画实验开始。

ex.s: The tour departs from Dam Square every hour on the hour, starting at 1:00 pm every day.
ex.t: 游览每天下午1:00开始，每小时整点从大坝广场出发。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: The destruction started three months ago.
ex.t: 破坏从三个月前开始。

ex.s: From now on, I started to play my football with classmates after school.
ex.t: 从那时起，我开始放学后和同学们一起踢足球。

ex.s: Meowing starts as soon as a baby cat is brought to life and uses it to get the mother's attention and be fed.
ex.t: 喵喵叫从小猫一出生就开始，它用这种方式引起猫妈妈的注意并得到喂养。

ex.s: Mari starts changing her life and discovers a world of diverse ”night people” who are hiding secrets.
ex.t: 玛丽开始改变自己的生活，发现了一个由隐藏着秘密、形形色色的“夜行人”组成的世界。

ex.s: From the minute reached our house, I started to read. knew this was extreme happiness, knew it at the time.
ex.t: 从到达我们家的那一刻起，我就开始读。我知道这是极度的快乐，当时就知道。

ex.s: Where do you start?
ex.t: 你从哪里开始？

ex.s: Here are some suggestions on where to start your Bangkok eating adventure.
ex.t: 以下是一些关于从哪里开始你的曼谷美食之旅的建议。

ex.s: Start with small tasks
ex.t: 从小任务开始

ex.s: I woke up most mornings with a dull, grey feeling as I forced myself out of bed to start the day.
ex.t: 大多数早晨我醒来时都带着一种沉闷、灰暗的感觉，强迫自己起床开始新的一天。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: But now is the time to set the record straight, which starts with questioning the idea that all social comparison is unhealthy.
ex.t: 但现在是纠正错误认知的时候了，而这要从质疑"所有社会比较都不健康"这种观点开始。

ex.s: Since he first started   12   his car to the young people.
ex.t: 自从他第一次开始___12___把他的车交给年轻人。

ex.s: Her owners started to get worried.
ex.t: 它的主人们开始担心起来。

ex.s: If you are looking for the best comedies on tour and brilliant live music, you should start here.
ex.t: 如果你在寻找最好的巡演喜剧和精彩的现场音乐，你应该从这里开始。

defs.def: to move suddenly and quickly because you are surprised or afraid 突然一惊
（给出首要理由）首先，第一

ex.s: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
ex.t: 在第一部分，我阐述了数字极简主义的哲学基础，先审视那些让许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，接着详细讨论数字极简主义理念。

ex.s: However you start, remember there is no better time to start than right now, for you'll never be more alive than you are at this moment.
ex.t: 无论你如何开始，记住没有比现在更好的开始时间，因为你再也不会比此刻更充满活力了。

defs.def: at the beginning 起初；开始时

ex.s: Register online or fill out a Group Play Registration Form with multiple date and start time options.
ex.t: 在线注册，或填写团体活动注册表，提供多个日期和开始时间选项。

ex.s: ●Set a starting time.
ex.t: ●定一个开始时间。

defs.def: to begin to move 开始活动；动身
to begin happening; to begin doing sth 进行（或开展）起来

ex.s: Mom  41  me to start crying, but I just sat there for a minute.
ex.t: 妈妈___41___我哭起来，但我只是在那里坐了一会儿。

defs.def: to begin by doing or being sth 首先进行；一开始是

ex.s: She says: “I’m sure I wasn’t much of a help to start with painting the rooms and putting down the flooring throughout the house.
ex.t: 她说：我确信一开始粉刷房间和铺设全屋地板时，我帮不上什么忙。

defs.def: to make sb begin doing sth 使开始（做某事）
to help sb begin doing sth 帮助某人开始（某事）

ex.s: 46   Meanwhile, positive thinking can help to stop negative self-talks and start to form a positive view on an issue.
ex.t: 46   同时，积极思考能帮助停止消极的自我对话，并开始对事物形成积极的看法。

ex.s: It’s more likely that none of us start a conversation because it’s awkward and challenging, or we think it’s annoying and unnecessary.
ex.t: 更有可能的是，没有人开始对话是因为这很尴尬且具有挑战性，或者我们认为这很烦琐且没有必要。

ex.s: I started doing anything I could to help them build a little （10）     ．Most important， I began to treat them like （11）     ． That summer， when the other teams enjoyed their （12）      ， we met every day and （13）     passing and kicking the football．
ex.t: 我开始尽我所能帮助他们建立一点（10）____。最重要的是，我开始把他们当作（11）____。那年夏天，当其他队伍享受他们的（12）____时，我们每天碰面，并（13）____传接和踢足球。

ex.s: Interviewer: So what helped when you first started high school?
ex.t: 采访者：那么你刚开始上高中时，什么帮助了你？

ex.s: For example, to find out the answer to the question“What did Lisa find most helpful when she started high school?”, you would look for the key words“helpful”and“started high school”.
ex.t: 例如，要找出“Lisa在开始上高中时最有帮助的是什么？”这个问题的答案，您可以查找关键词“有帮助”和“开始上高中”。

ex.s: Start a business using the help of your local library.
ex.t: 利用当地图书馆的帮助来创业。

ex.s: Go to the government website to learn about programs and online tools available to help people under 30 build skills, find a job or start businesses all year round.
ex.t: 访问政府网站，了解可帮助30岁以下人群提升技能、找工作或全年创业的项目和在线工具。

ex.s: To help him start a hobby
ex.t: 为了帮他培养爱好

defs.def: to begin to do sth, especially in business or work 开始从事，着手（某工作）；从业

ex.s: It takes sunscreen about fifteen minutes to start working, and that's plenty of time for your skin to absorb a day's worth of Vitamin D.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 这需要15分钟的防晒霜才能开始工作，那么你的皮肤就有足够的时间吸收一天的维生素D.

ex.s: Starting a business.
ex.t: 创业。

defs.def: to have a particular intention when you begin sth 最初想要；起先打算

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。有一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点被一段台阶绊倒。这些台阶会通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些神秘莫测的台阶。

defs.def: the point at which sth begins 开头；开端

ex.s: Yes, it was a huge goodbye in so many ways, but it was also the start of something new — an adventure in multigenerational living.
ex.t: 是的，从很多方面说这是一次巨大的告别，但它也是新事物的开端——一场多代同堂生活的冒险。

ex.s: Going to the cafe starts her day off good and gets her ready for class.
ex.t: 去咖啡馆让她有了一个美好的开端，也为上课做好了准备。

ex.s: The light，about one-thousandth of the amount needed to read by，is just a start.
ex.t: 这种光约为阅读所需光强的千分之一，只是一个开端。

ex.s: Dr Nieca Goldberg, a spokeswoman for the American Heart Association, says Levine's findings are a great start.
ex.t: 美国心脏协会发言人涅卡·戈德堡博士说，莱文的发现是一个很好的开端。

ex.s: （1）The passage starts with the story of Cervantes to show that     ．
ex.t: （ 1 ）段落以塞万提斯的故事开头，以此表明。

ex.s: Most obviously, the men displayed lower blood sugar levels at the start of their workouts when they had skipped breakfast than when they had eaten.
ex.t: 最明显的是，这些男性在不吃早餐时开始锻炼的血糖水平比吃早餐时更低。

ex.s: Not the start I wanted!
ex.t: 不是我想要的开始！

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 这个新的开始让我有机会重新定义自己，并发现一个全新的“酷”的版本。

ex.s: What changes offered a new start to the author after his family moved? （no more than 15 words）
ex.t: 搬家后，是什么变化给了作者一个新的开始？（不超过15个词）

ex.s: At the start of this year, foreigners living in Italy amounted to 4.56 million of a total population of 60.6 million, or 7.5 percent, with immigrants’ children accounting for an even larger percentage of births in Italy.
ex.t: 今年年初，居住在意大利的外国人达456万，占总人口6060万的7.5%，而移民子女在意大利出生人口中所占比例甚至更高。

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED收获了热烈好评，它从一开始就被设计成短期实验；Blue Hill此后已恢复常规菜单。

ex.s: If you want to turn over a new leaf, though, one top tip is that it helps to choose a significant date that signals the start of a new “chapter”.
ex.t: 不过，如果你想重新开始，一个顶级建议是：选择一个象征新“章节”开始的重要日期会很有帮助。

ex.s: What was a problem facing Jaramillo at the start of the program?
ex.t: Jaramillo在节目开始时遇到什么问题？

defs.def: the act or process of beginning sth 开始

ex.s: When he got older, John started to wonder if this process could be used to clean up the messes people were making.
ex.t: 长大后，约翰开始想这个过程是否可以用来清理人类制造的垃圾。

defs.def: the opportunity that you are given to begin sth in a successful way 起始优势；良好的基础条件

ex.s: Trainees also get a good start on their Wilderness Survival badge as they learn about water- and land-survival through designed tasks and their search and rescue of “downed” pilot.
ex.t: 学员们在荒野求生徽章上也有一个良好的开端，他们通过设计好的任务和对"坠机"飞行员的搜救来学习水上和陆上生存知识。

ex.t: 起点：斯克拉托斯桥

ex.t: 起点：Deerpark汽车公园

ex.s: Start Point: The Town Hall

ex.t: 起点：基尔布兰尼什森林休闲区

ex.t: 他们有一个相同的起点。

defs.def: an amount of time or distance that sb has as an advantage over other people at the beginning of a race 起跑的提前量（时间或距离）

ex.s: I watched as David moved up to the starting line with the other runners.
ex.t: 我看着David和其他跑步者一起走到起跑线上。

ex.s: Three years ago, schools in Edina, Minnesota, changed the start time from 7:25 am to 8:30 am.
ex.t: 三年前，明尼苏达州Edina的学校将开学时间从早上7点25分改为早上8点30分。

ex.s: For Cruse, what started out as a way to kill time has now developed into a way to make a difference in the heart of a child.
ex.t: 对克鲁斯来说，最初打发时间的方式，如今已变成在孩子心灵中产生积极影响的方式。

ex.s: They are now getting a head start on next year’s toy workload.
ex.t: 他们现在已经开始着手准备明年的玩具制作工作了。

defs.def: a race or competition that sb has taken part in （参加的）比赛
an act of moving your body quickly and suddenly because you are surprised, afraid, etc. 突然一惊

ex.t: 让我们先来看看《学生指南》，开启你的学术之旅吧！
